blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adding abstention to a task-adapted multimodal model can discard correct answers, including capabilities acquired during adaptation. We formulate abstention repair as maximizing correct abstention on unanswerable questions under a budget on newly lost correct answers. We propose ReFrain (Regression-Free Abstention), which combines a linear probe on first-token logits, threshold calibration on held-out image clusters, and a deterministic veto that replaces rejected outputs with the displayed "none of the above" option while preserving all other responses. "Regression-free" denotes zero loss on the calibration set at the zero-budget target. All abstention methods in our main comparison start from the same answering-SFT checkpoint; we separately track lost correct answers, repaired errors, and retained SFT gains. On Qwen2.5-VL-3B, ReFrain at zero budget retains all 57 SFT-gained answers with no losses and improves correct abstention by 7.30 percentage points. At a 0.5% calibration budget, it reaches 74.05% correct abstention with 8 losses and retains 55 gains; CLIP-UP EmbLoRA reaches 64.65% with 62 losses, 41 repairs, and 40 retained gains. The same probe at its default threshold loses 298 correct answers. With models and thresholds frozen, confirmation on 228 independent question clusters yields 66.05% correct abstention and no losses at the 0.5% point, exceeding EmbLoRA by 32.72 percentage points. Ordinary refusal SFT achieves higher correct abstention at greater regression cost. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/ModeLiberaL/ReFrain.
blocks.zh: 在适应任务的多模式模式中加上弃权,可以放弃正确的答案,包括在适应过程中获得的能力。 我们提出弃权的修补办法,是尽量正确地弃权,在预算中不回答新丢失的正确答案。 我们提出ReFrain(Revention-Free Abservation),它结合了一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一的线性探测,被搁置图像集群的阈值校正,以及决定性否决权,在保留所有其他反应的同时,用显示的"没有上述任何"选项来取代被拒绝的产出. "回向无"表示零预算目标设定的校正损失为零. 在我们的主要比较中,所有弃权方法都从同一个回答-SFT检查站开始;我们分别追踪丢失的正确答案,修复错误,并保留SFT的收益。 在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上,以零预算的ReFrain保留了全部57个SFT获得的答案,没有亏损,并改进了7.30个百分点的正确弃权. 在0.5%的校准预算中,它达到74.05%的正确弃权率,8个损失,保留55个收益;CLIP-UP EmbLORA达到64.65%,损失62个,修复41个,保留40个收益. 同一探测器在其默认阈值上丢失了298个正确的答案. 由于模型和阈值被冻结,228个独立问题集群的确认结果为66.05%正确弃权,在0.5%时没有损失,超过32.72个百分点。 普通拒绝SFT以更高的回归成本实现更高的正确弃权. 代码和复制材料:https://github.com/ModeLiberaL/ReFrain.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
After a multimodal model has been adapted to its task, it still needs the ability to abstain: to stop guessing on inputs where the evidence is insufficient or the question is invalid.
This order is close to practice: the model first learns to do the task, and its behavior when it cannot answer reliably is constrained afterwards.
The order also determines how the cost of the abstention stage should be counted.
Adaptation has already made the model answer a set of questions correctly, some of which adaptation has only just corrected; if the abstention stage turns these answers back into errors, overall accuracy may change very little while the specific capabilities that users can rely on have changed.
We call adding abstention to an already-adapted answer model abstention repair , and we measure its cost against the records that this model answered correctly.
blocks.zh:
在多式联运模式适应其任务之后,它仍然需要能够投弃权票:在证据不足或问题无效的情况下,停止对投入的猜测。
这种顺序接近实践:模型首先学会完成任务,其无法可靠回答时的行为随后会受到限制.
该命令还确定如何计算弃权阶段的费用。
适应已经使模型正确地回答了一组问题,其中一些适应只是刚刚得到纠正;如果弃权阶段将这些答案反倒为错误,总体准确性可能变化很小,而用户可以依赖的特定能力却发生了变化.
我们要求在一个已经适应的解答模式中增加弃权者,

blocks.en:
MM-UPD turns part of the answering boundary into a measurable task: the correct answer is absent from the candidate set (absent answer detection, AAD), the candidate set is incompatible with the question (incompatible answer set detection, IASD), or the image is incompatible with the question (incompatible visual question detection, IVQD) [ 16 ] .
In these cases, stronger domain knowledge does not necessarily make the current input solvable.
For example, knowing the general properties of an object cannot replace the corresponding evidence that is missing from the current image, and knowing the answer to the open-ended question does not make a candidate set without the correct answer yield a correct option.
Joint evaluation on Standard and UPD therefore requires both valid answering and correct abstention.
blocks.zh:
MM-UPD将答题边界的一部分转换为可计量的任务:在候选集(缺答检测,AAD)中缺少正确的答案,候选集与问题不相容(不相容的答案集检测,IASD),或者图像与问题不相容(不相容的视觉问题检测,IVQD)[16].
在这些情况下,较强的域知识不一定能使当前输入溶解.
例如,知道一个对象的一般属性不能取代当前图像所缺失的相应证据,知道对无限制问题的答案并不能使一个没有正确答案的候选集产生正确的选项.
因此,对《标准》和《统一规则》的联合评价要求有效回答和正确的弃权。

blocks.en:
Existing approaches differ in where the abstention decision is made: continuing to train the model on abstention examples [ 10 ] , injecting a visual–textual matching signal into the input [ 22 ] , perturbing the input several times and deciding by the stability of the outputs [ 33 ] , or training a classifier that abstains directly at the output [ 34 ] .
TAPS separates accuracy training from post-hoc selection and compares this approach with abstention training at matched coverage [ 32 ] .
We study the subsequent upgrade of an already-adapted answerer: in our main comparison, all abstention schemes start from the same checkpoint obtained by supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on answering, the answer-SFT checkpoint , and we record which answers each scheme changes relative to that checkpoint.
There are two reasons.
First, net accuracy lets losses and corrections cancel: at our common starting point, the Standard accuracy of CLIP-UP EmbLoRA is only 0.37 percentage points below the starting point, and this difference contains 62 lost original correct answers and 41 corrections.
Second, only with the same starting point can the answers changed by each scheme be compared record by record, including the answers that answer SFT has just corrected.
blocks.zh:
在作出弃权决定时,现行做法不同:继续就弃权的例子对模式进行培训[10],在输入中注入视觉-文字匹配信号[22],多次扰乱输入,并以产出的稳定性决定[33],或培训直接投弃权票的分类员[34]。
TAPS将准确性培训与选后性培训区分开来,并将这种方法与相应覆盖面的弃权性培训进行比较[32].
我们研究一个已经适应的回答者随后的升级:在我们的主要比较中,所有弃权计划都从同一个检查点开始,这个检查点是通过在回答时经过监督的微调(SFT)得到的,即回答-SFT检查点,我们记录了每个计划相对于该检查点的变化的答案。
有两个原因。
一,净准确度允许损失和更正取消:在我们共同的起步点,CLIP-UP EmbLORA的标准准确度仅比起步点低0.37个百分点,这一差异包含62个丢失的原正确答案和41个更正.
其次,只有在相同的起点下,每个方案所改变的答案才能通过记录来比较记录,包括刚刚更正的答案SFT.

blocks.en:
Accordingly, we state abstention repair as a constrained problem: maximize the correct-abstention rate on unanswerable questions, subject to the original-correct loss not exceeding a budget ε \varepsilon .
The original-correct loss is the negative flip rate of the model-update literature [ 30 , 28 ] .
The constrained form follows the existing formulation of regression-free model updates, in which the negative flip rate is constrained to be zero or at most a given constant [ 28 ] .
The accompanying shared-checkpoint protocol specifies that all schemes use the same checkpoint, fit only on the training set, select operating points only on the calibration set, and neither tune thresholds nor select checkpoints on the evaluation set; besides net metrics, losses, corrections, and the retention of SFT-gained records are reported record by record.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们指出,弃权修复是一个受限制的问题:在不超过预算额的原始正确损失情况下,尽量提高无法回答问题的正确放弃率。
原正亏是模型更新文献的负倒转率 [30, 28].
被限制的形式遵循了现有的无回归模型更新的表述,其中负倒转率被限制为0或最多为给定常数 [28].
附带的共享检查点协议规定,所有计划都使用同一个检查站,只适合培训组,只在校准组上选择操作点,在评价组上既不选择调值阈值,也不选择检查站;除了净度表,损失,更正,以及保留SFT获得的记录,都记录下来.

blocks.en:
Under this formulation we propose ReFrain (Regression-Free Abstention).
It has three steps: a linear probe on the full-vocabulary logits of the first token gives an answerability score; on held-out image clusters, the largest threshold that meets the budget on the original-correct loss is selected; and when the score is below the threshold, the output is replaced with the “none of the above” (NOTA) option actually displayed in the question, while all other outputs stay unchanged.
The scorer is the probe of LVLM-LP.
Replacing the output directly on a classifier’s decision also has precedents: LVLM-LP generates a template answer instead when its probe judges the input unanswerable, and the appendix of CLIP-UP gives a baseline that outputs a fixed refusal string after classification [ 34 , 22 ] .
For post-hoc abstention baselines that threshold a confidence score on a frozen model, the threshold has been selected by an aggregate metric on a validation set [ 7 ] .
ReFrain calibrates the threshold against the original-correct loss of the adapted checkpoint; our controls compare this choice with the classifier’s default threshold while holding the score and executor fixed.
Executing by veto only, without rewriting, gives one-sidedness: an original correct answer can be lost only by being vetoed and is never changed to another substantive option; the correct-abstention rate on unanswerable questions is not below that of the starting point; and both the loss and the correct-abstention rate are monotone in the threshold.
Calibration therefore needs only labeled answerable records, and changing the budget requires no retraining.
“Regression-free” in the name refers to the calibration target at ε = 0 \varepsilon=0 : no original correct answer is lost on the calibration set.
This is an empirical constraint on a finite calibration set.
For a new image cluster that is exchangeable with the K K calibration clusters, a standard order-statistic argument bounds the probability of any loss at this target by 1 / ( K + 1 ) 1/(K+1) (Property 3 ); the realized loss on the evaluation set is reported separately.
blocks.zh:
根据这一提法,我们提议退缩。
它有三步:在第一个令牌的全活方位对数上的线性探测器给出一个可答分;在被搁置的图像集群上,选择符合原正确损失预算的最大阈值;当分数低于阈值时,输出被替换为“在问题中实际显示的无上(NOTA)选项”,而所有其他产出保持不变.
计分器是LVLM-LP的探测器.
将输出直接取而代之于分类者的决定也有先例:LVLM-LP生成一个模板解答,当它的探测器判断出输入不能回答,而CLIP-UP的附录给出了一个基准,在分类后输出出一个固定的拒绝字符串[34,22].
对于在被冻结模型上设定置信分数阈值的弃权后基线,该阈值已经由一个验证集[7]上的汇总度量标准选定。
将阈值校正为调整后的检查站的原正确损失;我们的控制将这一选择与分类者的默认阈值进行比较,同时将分数和执行器固定。
仅以否决方式执行,不重写,就给出了片面性:原本正确的答案只能被否决而丢失,永远不能被改为另一个实质性选项;对无法回答的问题的正确回避率不低于起点;损失率和正确回避率在门槛中都是单调的.
因此,校正只需要贴有标签的可回答记录,改变预算不需要再培训。
名称中的"回向无"指校正目标为:QQ=0\varepsilon=0:校正集上没有丢失原始正确答案.
这是对有限校正的实证限制。
对于可与 K K 校正集群交换的新图像集群, 标准命令- 统计参数将目标上的任何损失概率限制为 1 / (K + 1) 1/ (K+1) (Property 3) ; 评估集上实现的损失单独报告.

blocks.en:
On the shared Qwen2.5-VL-3B [ 3 ] answer-SFT checkpoint B1 , ReFrain loses no original correct answer on the 5,626 Standard records of the evaluation set, retains all 57 SFT-gained records, and raises the correct-abstention rate from 54.63% to 61.94%.
ReFrain ( ε = 0.5 % \varepsilon{=}0.5\% ) loses 8, with a correct-abstention rate of 74.05%.
The same probe, abstaining at its default probability threshold, has a correct-abstention rate of 92.16% and loses 298 original correct answers.
From the same starting point, CLIP-UP EmbLoRA loses 62 and corrects 41, with a correct-abstention rate of 64.65%; plain abstention SFT has a correct-abstention rate of 87.47%, loses 140 and corrects 33, and does not pass the joint criterion (Section 3.6 ) on the evaluation set.
With calibration and the executor fixed and only the scorer replaced, the two logits probes have correct-abstention rates of 74.05% and 75.40% at the 0.5% budget, and the other seven scorer configurations range from 56.59% to 67.20%.
On two original base models without SFT, the zero-budget point of the same pipeline loses 2 and 4 original correct answers on the evaluation set, with correct-abstention rates 2.04 and 2.85 percentage points above EmbLoRA.
blocks.zh:
在共用的Qwen2.5-VL-3B[3]答-SFT检查站上 B1,ReFrain在评价集5,626个标准记录上没有失去原始的正确答案,保留了全部57个SFT获得的记录,并将正确录取率从54.63%提高到61.94%.
ReFrain (QQ = 0.5 %\varepsilon = 0.5 = 5 = )输了8分,正确录取率为74.05%.
同一探测器在其默认概率阈值上弃权,其正确失能率为92.16%,并丢失了298个原正确答案.
从同一起点出发,CLIP-UP EmbLORA输了62分并更正了41分,正确弃权率为64.65%;平庸弃权的SFT正确弃权率为87.47%,损失140分并更正了33分,没有通过评价套的联合标准(第3.6节).
随着校正和执行器固定,只有分数被替换,两个对数探测器在0.5%的预算中的正确取出率为74.05%和75.40%,而其他七个分数的配置从56.59%到67.20%.
在两个没有SFT的原始基模型上,同管线的零预算点在评价集上损失了2个和4个原始正确答案,正确吸收率为2.04分和比EmbLORA高2.85分.

blocks.en:
After the models and thresholds were frozen, we ran a single independent confirmation on AI2D images [ 12 ] that were not used in the development of this project.
Neither operating point lost an original correct answer on the 912 Standard records, and the correct-abstention rate rose by 20.10 and 44.36 percentage points, respectively.
The trained branches both lose and correct answers on the confirmation set: EmbLoRA loses 7 and corrects 13; plain abstention SFT loses 4 and corrects 5, passes the joint criterion, and has a correct-abstention rate 4.90 percentage points above ReFrain ( ε = 0.5 % \varepsilon{=}0.5\% ).
ReFrain does not correct the errors of the answer model, which is the price of one-sidedness: on the confirmation set, the point estimates of the net Standard change of the two trained branches are positive, with intervals that contain zero.
blocks.zh:
在模型和阈值被冻结后,我们在AI2D图像上运行了一个单一的独立确认[12],这些图像没有用于这个项目的开发.
操作点都没有在"912"标准记录上丢失了原始的正确答案,正确录取率分别上升了20.10分和44.36分.
训练有素的分支在确认集上既输了,又正确回答: EmbLORA输了7分,正确13分;平庸弃权的SFT输了4分,更正了5分,通过了联合标准,在ReFrain(QQ=0.5%\varepsilon=0.5\%)以上拥有4.90分的正确放弃率.
ReFrain没有纠正答案模型的错误,即单面性的价格:在确认集上,两个被训练分支净标准变化的点估计是正的,间隔为零.

blocks.en:
This paper makes three contributions.
First, problem and protocol: we state abstention repair after answer adaptation as a problem constrained by the original-correct loss, give a shared-checkpoint protocol and a taxonomy of schemes by where the abstention decision is made, and report the retention of SFT-gained records as a separate readout.
Second, method: ReFrain and its one-sidedness properties, which reduce output-level abstention repair to a frontier parameterized by the threshold, on which the budget selects a point.
Third, evidence: on the same checkpoint we compare ReFrain, two parameter-update schemes, and the configurations obtained by replacing the scorer; we repeat the same pipeline on two original base models; and we run a single confirmation on independent images after freezing.
The main numbers are reported as direct paired differences within the same starting point; results across base models measure how the same pipeline performs when it is fitted separately on each.
blocks.zh:
本文件提出了三项意见。
首先,问题和协议:我们表示,在回答修改后弃权修复是一个受到原正确损失制约的问题,给出一个共享检查点协议和一个方案分类,由弃权决定地点,并将保留SFT获得的记录作为单独读出。
第二,方法: ReFrain及其单面性能,将输出级弃修减为以阈值为参数的边框参数,由预算在该参数上选择出分.
第三,证据:在同一检查点上,我们比较ReFrain,两个参数更新方案,和通过替换计分器获得的配置;我们在两个原始基模型上重复同样的管道;在被冻结后,我们在独立图像上运行一个单一的确认.
主要数字报告为同一起点内的直接对接差异;基准模型之间的结果衡量同一管线在分别安装在每一管线上时如何运行。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
UPD concerns inputs that are unsolvable by construction, and limits blanket abstention by evaluating each Standard question together with its unsolvable counterpart [ 16 ] .
Reliable VQA studies the trade-off between answer coverage and the risk of error, and ReCoVERR further examines how to reduce unnecessary abstention [ 25 , 18 ] .
Together they show that the practical value of abstention depends both on stopping wrong outputs and on keeping valid answers.
blocks.zh:
UPD涉及无法通过建筑解决的投入,通过评估每个标准问题及其无法解决的对应方来限制一概弃权。
可靠的VQA研究了答案覆盖范围与出错风险之间的取舍,ReCOVERR进一步研究了如何减少不必要的弃权[25,18].
它们共同表明,弃权的实际价值取决于停止错误的产出和保持有效答案。

blocks.en:
TAPS combines accuracy-oriented post-training with a frozen answerer and an external confidence estimator [ 32 ] .
Its main implementation uses GRPO for accuracy training and a hidden-state correctness probe for selection; its matched-coverage analysis separates improvements in answering from improvements in rejection.
Our main experiment instead compares subsequent abstention schemes from one shared answer-SFT checkpoint, calibrates veto thresholds against its original-correct loss, and tracks the retention of records newly corrected by SFT.
This protocol measures the cost of adding abstention after task adaptation, complementing TAPS’s comparison of alternative training routes.
blocks.zh:
TAPS将精度导向后训练与被冷冻的回答器和外置信心估计器相结合[32].
其主要实施使用GRPO进行准确性培训和一个隐藏状态的正确性探测器进行选择;它的配对覆盖分析将回答改进与拒绝改进区分开来.
我们的主要试验是比较一个共享的SFT检查站随后的弃权计划,校准否决权阈值与原先正确的损失,跟踪SFT新更正的记录的保留情况。
这项议定书衡量任务调整后增加弃权费用,补充了TAPS对替代培训路线的比较。

blocks.en:
LVLM-LP trains probes on the information in token distributions [ 34 ] ; VL-Uncertainty estimates the instability of outputs under visual and textual perturbations [ 33 ] ; CLIP-UP provides a visual–textual matching signal through structured CLIP correlation vectors [ 22 ] .
These methods represent different sources of information and are the direct points of comparison for understanding the differences among the operating points studied here.
blocks.zh:
LVLM-LP列车对符号分布中的信息进行探测[34];VL-不确定性在视觉和文字扰动下估计出输出的不稳定性[33];CLIP-UP通过结构化的CLIP相关向量提供视觉-文字匹配信号[22].
这些方法代表不同的信息来源,是了解本文所研究的操作点之间的差异的直接比较点.

blocks.en:
LRP compares hidden-state and attention probes in OCR question answering [ 31 ] ; BICR trains a correctness scorer on the difference between the states under the real image and under a black image [ 13 ] ; ACR fuses the maximum softmax probability (MSP) with a correctness prediction through a learnable gate [ 20 ] .
These works provide different scoring mechanisms for a frozen answerer.
We plug multiple-choice adaptations of BICR and ACR into the calibrate and veto steps of ReFrain as scorers and compare them on the same B1 (Sections 4.5 – 4.6 ).
blocks.zh:
LRP比较了OCR问题回答中的隐藏状态和注意力探测器[31];BICR在真实图像下和黑色图像下对状态差异的正确分分仪进行训练[13];ACR通过可学习的门将最大软max概率(MSP)与正确性预测相接[20].
这些作品为被冷冻的回答者提供了不同的评分机制.
我们把BICR和ACR的多选择调整加入ReFrain作为计分员的校准和否决步骤,并把它们比作同一B1(第4.5至4.6节)。

blocks.en:
CARA studies the detection of insufficient context [ 15 ] ; MAD-MED trains with weighted abstention examples [ 10 ] ; SAVOR adds calibration and abstention to a reinforcement-learning reward [ 4 ] ; Variational VQA improves selective prediction through the variance of a parameter posterior [ 26 ] .
They cover different stages—evidence recognition, generation policy, and uncertainty-aware training—and give a broader background for applications of abstention.
blocks.zh:
CARA研究检测背景不足[15];MAD-MED列车采用加权弃权例子[10];SAVOR在强化学习奖励中增加校正和弃权[4];变相 VQA通过后参数相差来改进选择性预测 [26].
它们涵盖不同的阶段——证据确认、生成政策和对不确定性的认识培训——并为弃权申请提供更广泛的背景。

blocks.en:
CLIP-UP injects the correlation signal into the multimodal model, in an Emb and an EmbLoRA form; its appendix also gives a classify-then-abstain baseline: a logistic regression on the correlation vector decides whether the input is answerable, a fixed refusal string is output when the input is classified as unanswerable, and the model answers otherwise.
The paper reports that this classifier labels only 46.27% of Circular Standard questions as answerable [ 22 ] .
LVLM-LP also describes probe-guided decoding: when the probe judges the input unanswerable, a template answer is generated instead [ 34 ] .
Dr. No steers sparse-autoencoder features on a frozen model to induce abstention, and compares on MM-UPD a set of post-hoc abstention baselines that threshold a confidence score, with thresholds selected on a validation split to maximize mean Dual accuracy [ 7 ] .
The classify-then-abstain baseline, probe-guided decoding, and the thresholded post-hoc baselines belong, like ReFrain, to output-level override (Section 3.3 ): the answer model is frozen, and a scalar score decides whether the output is replaced.
These methods and TAPS share the external-selection architecture with ReFrain.
Our experiments compare scorers and threshold rules within this architecture, using the original-correct loss of the frozen answer model to select the operating point.
Within the output-level override family we fix the executor and replace the scorer and the threshold source separately; schemes in the other families keep their own training and execution and are compared as wholes.
The two kinds of comparison answer questions about information quality and about end-to-end effect, respectively.

blocks.en:
Minimizing one type of error subject to an upper bound on the other is the setting of Neyman–Pearson classification [ 19 ] .
This setting, and finite-sample methods such as conformal risk control [ 2 ] , have been used to calibrate abstention thresholds.
For language models, what is constrained is the rate at which wrong answers are not intercepted [ 17 ] , or the rates at which unanswerable questions are answered and answerable ones are answered wrongly [ 23 ] ; for vision–language models, what is constrained is the error or hallucination risk on the answered part [ 24 , 29 ] .
These works constrain erroneous outputs, and wrongly abstaining on correct answers is the side that is minimized or only reported.
Our constraint runs in the opposite direction: what is constrained is the fraction of records answered correctly by the frozen answer model that are vetoed, and what is maximized is the correct-abstention rate on unanswerable inputs.
Our calibration rule is an empirical constraint on a finite calibration set.
At a nonzero budget it gives no population-level guarantee; at the zero budget, the order-statistic arguments of these two settings bound the probability of a loss on a new exchangeable image cluster (Property 3 ).
The realized loss on the evaluation set is reported separately, with paired intervals.

blocks.en:
The model-update literature calls a sample that the old model answers correctly and the new model answers wrongly a negative flip, measures regression by the negative flip rate, and reduces negative flips by training the new model with distillation or by using model ensembles [ 30 , 28 ] .
Among these, Xie et al. [28] write the regression-free model update as a constrained optimization problem, constraining the negative flip rate to be zero or at most a given constant, and then relax it into joint training with a distillation term.
Another line keeps the predictions of the old model at inference time and chooses between, or fuses, the old and new predictions sample by sample [ 21 , 14 ] .
For language models, negative flips are also used to measure the regression caused by model version updates and by preference alignment [ 5 , 36 ] .
We adopt the negative flip rate as the measure together with the constrained form, and change the object to the addition of abstention: the reference model is a checkpoint that has completed answer adaptation, and the objective is the correct-abstention rate on unanswerable inputs.
ReFrain neither trains a new answer model nor chooses between two answer models; there is only one answer model, the only alternative output is abstention, and the veto threshold is calibrated against the original-correct loss on held-out image clusters.
In the post-training setting, we additionally condition on the records that the previous stage newly made correct, to characterize how a capability is retained after it is acquired.

模型更新文献称一个样本,旧模型正确回答,而新模型错误地回答一个负翻转,用负翻转率来度量回归,并用蒸馏来训练新模型或者使用模型综艺来减少负翻转 [30,28].
其中, 谢等. [28] 将无回归模型更新写成受限制的优化问题,将负倒转率限制为0或最多为给定常数,再用蒸馏名词放轻松入联合训练.
另一行在推断时间保留了对旧模型的预测,并按样本在新旧预测样本之间或引信之间作出选择[21,14].
对于语言模型,也使用负翻来测量由模型版本更新和偏好对接所引发的回归 [5,36].
我们采用负倒转率作为衡量标准,加上受约束的形式,并将对象改为加弃: 参考模型是一个已完成答题调整的检查点,目标是对无法回答输入的正确忽略率.

在培训后的情况下,我们还附加条件,要求前一阶段新纠正的记录,说明在获得后如何保留能力。

Unless stated otherwise, the numbers in this section are measured on 𝖤 \mathsf{E} , differences between rates are given in percentage points (pp), and intervals are paired 95% intervals over image clusters (Section 3.6 ).

Both ReFrain operating points and EmbLoRA pass the joint criterion relative to B1 .
ReFrain keeps every original correct answer of B1 and raises the correct-abstention rate by 7.30 pp, with a 95% interval of [6.21, 8.37].

blocks.en:
The evaluation-set loss of ReFrain ( ε = 0.5 % \varepsilon{=}0.5\% ) is 8 of 5,626 Standard records, of which 2 are SFT-gained records and 6 are other records that B1 answered correctly.
Relative to EmbLoRA, its correct-abstention rate is 9.40 pp higher, with an interval of [7.77, 11.05]; it loses 54 fewer original correct answers, a difference of 0.96 pp with an interval of [0.52, 1.47].

评估设定的ReFrain损失(= 0.5%\varepsilon = 0.5= 5 626)为8起。 标准记录,其中2个为SFT获得的记录,6个为B1正确回答的其他记录.

blocks.en:
Plain abstention SFT starts from the same B1 , uses the same 1,354 training records and three epochs of training, and takes the LoRA configuration and the learning rate of EmbLoRA.
Its target is the correct option or the NOTA letter in the common multiple-choice format.
This branch has a higher correct-abstention rate and a higher Circular Dual than the other branches in Table 4 ; it loses 34 SFT-gained records and 106 other answers that B1 got right, and corrects 33 old errors.
Its Standard accuracy falls by 1.90 pp relative to B1 , with a 95% interval of [ − - 2.84, − - 1.01], so it does not pass the accuracy part of the joint criterion.
blocks.zh:
完全弃权的SFT从同一个B1开始,使用相同的1,354个训练记录和三个训练时代,并取自LORA配置和EmbLORA的学习率.
它的目标是正确的选项或通用多选择格式的NOTA字母.
这个分支拥有高于表4中其他分支的正确吸收率和更高的循环双能;它损失了34个SFT获得的记录和106个B1得到正确的其他答案,并纠正了33个旧错误.
它的标准精度比B1下降了1.90pp,间隔为95% [− 2.84,− - 1.01],因此它不会通过联合标准的精度部分.

blocks.en:
Relative to plain abstention SFT, ReFrain ( ε = 0.5 % \varepsilon{=}0.5\% ) is 1.76 pp higher on Standard, with an interval of [0.89, 2.68], and 13.42 pp lower in correct-abstention rate, with an interval of [ − - 14.88, − - 11.90].

Figure 1 shows the abstention gain, the transitions of correct answers, and the retention of SFT-gained records together.

相对于平地弃权的SFT,ReFrain(XQ = 0.5%\varepsilon{=}0.5)在"标准"上高1.76pp,间隔为[0.89, 2.68];而13.42pp的正确弃权率更低,间隔为[−- 14.88,−- 11.90].

在SFT之后,B1的正确吸收率是比B0低1.80pp.
与 B0 相比, ReFrain, ReFrain(= 0.5%\varepsilon = 0.5 = ) 和 EmbLORA 的最终正确留级率更高,分别为 5.50, 17.62和 8.21 pp.

blocks.en: 4.4 A Common-Executor Control for CLIP Correlation Features
blocks.zh: 4.4 CLIP 关联特征的共同执行控制

blocks.en:
Appendix F.2 of CLIP-UP gives a mechanism that abstains directly after a classification of the correlation vector [ 22 ] .
We use the official Structure-CLIP weights [ 9 ] , multiply the normalized image embedding element-wise with each of the four question–candidate text embeddings, and concatenate the products; the NOTA candidate is excluded.
The original paper does not give the complete fitting hyperparameters of this classifier, so we report two mechanism ports: an unstandardized fit with C = 1 C=1 , and a fit selected by cross-validation over image clusters within 𝖳 \mathsf{T} .
The cross-validation chooses whether to standardize the features and a value of C ∈ { 0.01 , 0.1 , 1 , 10 , 100 } C\in\{0.01,0.1,1,10,100\} , and it selects the unstandardized fit with C = 100 C=100 .
The threshold rule and the executor are the same as for the logits probe (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh:
CLIP-UP的附录F.2给出了一个在对关联矢量进行分类后直接弃权的机制 [22].
我们使用正式结构- CLIP 权重 [9], 将正态图像嵌入元素与四个问题中的每个问题相乘, 将文本嵌入, 并压缩产品; NOTA 候选人被排除在外 。
最初的纸张没有给出这个分类器的完整配位超参数,所以我们报告两个机制端口:一个未标准化的配位C=1 C=1,和一个由T\mathsf{T}内图像集群的交叉验证选择的配位.
交叉验证选择是否将 C { { 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100} 的特性和值标准化,选择 C\ in 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100} , 选择未标准化的相配 C = 100 C = 100 C = 100 .
阈值规则和执行器与对数探测器相同(表6)。

Table 6: CLIP correlation-vector classifier on B1 , on 𝖤 \mathsf{E} , at its default threshold and under the calibration and executor of ReFrain.
The calibrated rows are ReFrain with the CLIP classifier as the scorer.
blocks.zh:
表 6: CLIP 关联- 显示器分类器在 B1 , E\ mathsf{E} 上, 在其默认阈值下, 在 ReFrain 的校正和执行器下.
被校正的行为ReFrain,以CLIP分类为分数.

blocks.en:
At the common 0.5% budget, the cross-validated CLIP classifier and the cross-validated logits probe both lose exactly 8 Standard answers; the correct-abstention rate of the logits probe is 17.46 pp higher, with a 95% interval of [15.71, 19.25].
The CLIP classifier retains all 57 SFT-gained records and the logits probe retains 55, which shows that the same total loss can correspond to different sets of lost records.
The classifier operating points that are not calibrated against the loss have high correct-abstention rates and veto a large number of original correct answers; after calibration, accuracy is retained, but the additional abstention gain is small.
At the low-loss operating points that we tested, this supports the internal logits score over the CLIP correlation features.
blocks.zh:
在普通的0.5%预算中,被交叉验证的CLIP分级器和被交叉验证的对数探测器都损失了完全8个标准答案;对数探测器的正确吸收率更高了17.46pp,间隔为95% [15.71,19.25].
CLIP分类器保留了全部57个SFT获得的记录,而记录器探测器保留了55个记录,这表明同样的总损失可以对应不同组丢失的记录.
分类器操作点不针对损失进行校正,有很高的正确取出率,并否决了大量原始正确答案;校正后,准确性被保留,但附加弃权收益很小.
在我们测试的低损失操作点, 这支持内部对数得分 超过CLIP相关特性。

blocks.en: Table 7 puts the default threshold next to the common calibration for the two cross-validated classifiers, all computed on the same B1 .
blocks.zh: 表7将两个交叉验证的分类器的默认阈值放在共同校正的旁边,这些分类器都在同一个B1上计算。

blocks.en: Table 7: Default threshold against common calibration for the two cross-validated classifiers on B1 , on 𝖤 \mathsf{E} .
blocks.zh: 表7:B1,E\mathsf{E}上两个交叉校正分类器的默认阈值。

blocks.en:
The default classification threshold does not retain the original accuracy with either feature; the common calibration against the loss brings both to operating points that pass the joint criterion.
Calibration also lowers abstention coverage, and the logits probe keeps more of the gain in correct-abstention rate at the calibrated operating point.
blocks.zh:
默认的分级阈值没有保留原有的准确性,其中任一特征;共同的校正与损失相比,使两者都达到通过联合标准的操作点.
校准还降低了弃权率,对数探测器在校准的操作点保持了更多正确吸收率的收益.

blocks.en: 4.5 A Multiple-Choice Adaptation of Adaptive Confidence Fusion
blocks.zh: 4.5 适应性信心融合的多选择适应

blocks.en:
ACR fuses MSP with a correctness signal and a gate signal that are produced by two MLPs [ 20 ] .
We adapt its inputs to the final-prompt hidden state of B1 and the logits of the options A–E, keep the answer model frozen and the 15 epochs of training, and report one variant with raw features and one with features standardized using statistics of 𝖳 \mathsf{T} only.
We call this adaptation ACR-MCQ.
Both variants use the same loss calibration and NOTA executor (Table 8 ).
blocks.zh:
ACR以正确信号和由两个MLP所出出门信号为MSP引信 [20].
我们调整它的投入,使其适应最后的 B1 隐藏状态和选项 A-E 的日志,保持解答模型和15个培训时代的冻结,并报告一个带有原始特征的变体,一个带有仅使用 T\ mathsf{T} 统计的标准化特征。
我们称它为ACR -MCQ
两个变体都使用相同的损失校正和NOTA执行器(表8.).

blocks.en:
Table 8: ACR-MCQ on B1 , on 𝖤 \mathsf{E} .
The calibrated rows are ReFrain with the ACR-MCQ score as the scorer.
blocks.zh:
表8:关于B1的ACR-MCQ,关于E\mathsf{E}.
校正行以ACR-MCQ分数为分数的ReFrain.

blocks.en:
With raw inputs, the gate equals 1 on the whole training set, and the deployed behavior equals MSP over the option space A–E; standardization on 𝖳 \mathsf{T} makes the gate vary with the input, and the correctness AUROC on 𝖤 \mathsf{E} rises from 0.806 to 0.913.
At the 0.5% calibration budget, the standardized variant has higher abstention coverage and also a larger evaluation-set loss.
Relative to this operating point, ReFrain ( ε = 0.5 % \varepsilon{=}0.5\% ) is 0.50 pp higher on Standard, with a 95% interval of [0.21, 0.81], and 6.85 pp higher in correct-abstention rate, with an interval of [5.32, 8.32].
blocks.zh:
使用原始输入,门在全训练集上等于1,被部署的行为在选项空间A-E上等于MSP;在T\mathsf{T}上的标准化使得门随输入而变化,而E\mathsf{E}上的AUROC的正确性从0.806升至0.913.
在0.5%的校准预算中,标准化变式的弃权率较高,而且评价设定的损失也较大。
相对于这个操作点,ReFrain(QQ = 0.5%\varepsilon{=}0.5)在"标准"上高出0.50pp,间隔为[0.21,0.81];而6.85pp的正确吸收率更高,间隔为[5.32,8.32].

blocks.en: 4.6 A Visual-Contrast Correctness Probe
blocks.zh: 4.6 视觉-连通正确性探测

blocks.en:
BICR trains a shared MLP on the final-prompt states under the real image and under a black image, with the correctness of the actual answer of B1 as the label and a joint objective of a weighted binary cross-entropy, a Brier term, and a ranking loss on positive examples [ 13 ] .
Within 𝖳 \mathsf{T} we make an 80/20 split by image cluster, run 50 trials of an Optuna search [ 1 ] , and then train the selected configuration on the full 𝖳 \mathsf{T} for 79 epochs. 𝖢𝖬 \mathsf{CM} is used only to calibrate the common loss threshold (Table 9 ).
blocks.zh:
BICR在真实图像下和黑色图像下在最终瞬间状态上运行一个共享的MLP,以B1作为标签的实际答案的正确性以及加权二进制交叉通缩,Brier名词的联合目标,以及正例的排名损失[13].
在 T\ mathsf{T} 内, 我们按图像集群进行 80/ 20 个分割, 运行 50 个 Optuna 搜索的试验 [ 1] , 然后在 T\ mathsf{T} 上为 79 个时代进行 训练 。 CM\mathsf{CM}仅用于校正常见损失阈值(表9).

blocks.en:
Table 9: BICR on B1 , on 𝖤 \mathsf{E} .
The calibrated rows are ReFrain with the BICR score as the scorer.
blocks.zh:
表9:B1上的BICR,E\mathsf{E}上的BICR.
校正行为以BICR分数为分数的ReFrain.

blocks.en:
The correctness AUROC of BICR on 𝖤 \mathsf{E} is 0.904.
At the common 0.5% budget it retains all SFT-gained records; the correct-abstention rate of ReFrain ( ε = 0.5 % \varepsilon{=}0.5\% ) is 15.82 pp higher, with a 95% interval of [14.25, 17.41], and the difference on Standard is 0.04 pp in favor of ReFrain ( ε = 0.5 % \varepsilon{=}0.5\% ), with an interval of [ − - 0.14, 0.20].
The ranking of overall correctness and the abstention gain at low loss are different readouts.
BICR and ACR predict whether the answer is correct, whereas our probe and the CLIP classifier predict whether the input is answerable, with Standard against UPD as the classes; the differences among these complete scorers therefore combine features, targets, and fitting procedures.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
When net accuracies are close, abstention branches can still change different numbers of original correct answers.
The difference between ReFrain ( ε = 0.5 % \varepsilon{=}0.5\% ) and EmbLoRA on B1 shows that the decomposition into losses and corrections complements the net metric.
For applications that continue to rely on existing answers, a deployer can explicitly choose a stricter retention point, or accept a small loss for higher abstention coverage.
blocks.zh:
当净速率接近时,弃权分支仍然可以改变不同的原正答数.
ReFrain(QQ = 0.5%\varepsilon = 0.5\%)和EmbLORA在B1上的区别表明分解为损失和校正补充了净度量.
对于继续依赖现有答案的应用程序,部署人员可以明确选择更严格的保留点,或者接受较高弃权率的小额损失.

blocks.en:
On 𝖤 \mathsf{E} and on the independent confirmation set 𝖨 \mathsf{I} , both preset operating points of ReFrain give a low original-correct loss and additional abstention.
Plain abstention SFT loses 140 of 5,626 on 𝖤 \mathsf{E} and 4 of 912 on 𝖨 \mathsf{I} , and passes the joint criterion on the latter; the retention cost of the trained branches varies with the evaluation population.
On 𝖨 \mathsf{I} , EmbLoRA reaches a higher net Standard accuracy through corrections, while ReFrain obtains more correct abstentions and keeps all original correct answers, which again shows the difference between net accuracy and the retention of behavior.
blocks.zh:
在 E\mathsf{E} 和独立的确认集 I\mathsf{I} 上, ReFrain 的预设操作点都给出了较低的原正失和额外的弃权.
SFT在E\mathsf{E}上损失了5,626分中的140分,在I\mathsf{I}上损失了912分中的4分,并在后者上通过了联合标准;受训分支的留用费用随评价人群而异.
在 I\mathsf{I}上,EmbLORA通过校正达到更高的净标准精度,而ReFrain获得更正确的弃权并保留所有原始的正确答案,这再次显示了净精度和保留行为之间的区别.

blocks.en:
The same probe pipeline has a lower correct-abstention rate on B1 than on B0 : 67.85% becomes 61.94% at the zero budget, and 80.56% becomes 74.05% at the 0.5% budget.
The abstention layer therefore needs to be evaluated again after answer adaptation.
The drop in the operating point alone does not yet separate the effects of a change in ranking, a change in calibration, and the reuse of the training set; the score distributions on 𝖳 \mathsf{T} and 𝖢𝖬 \mathsf{CM} and the ranking at low false-positive rates could separate these explanations further.
blocks.zh:
同一探测管道在B1上的正确吸收率低于B0:67.85%在零预算中变为61.94%,80.56%在0.5%的预算中占74.05%.
因此,在答复调整后,需要再次评估弃权层。
单是操作点的下降还不能将排名变化,校正变化,以及训练集再用的影响区分开来;T\mathsf{T}和CM\mathsf{CM}上的分数分布和低假阳性率的排名可以进一步区分这些解释.

blocks.en:
CLIP-UP provides a route of training and injection that is aimed directly at UPD; LVLM-LP is the direct source of the internal logits score; VL-Uncertainty provides a perturbation-based uncertainty control; MSP and the negative entropy are simple scorers that need no additional supervised learning.
The correlation-vector classifier in Appendix F.2 of CLIP-UP is the closest component control; BICR adds a visual-contrast correctness probe, and ACR-MCQ adds a learnable confidence fusion.
The comparison is organized by task, mechanism, and reproducibility, and does not merge numbers that papers report on different datasets into a single ranking.

CLIP-UP提供直接针对UPD的训练和注射路线;LVLM-LP是内部对数分数的直接来源;VL-不确定性提供以扰动为主的不确定性控制;MSP和负等均是简单的分数器,不需要额外的有监督的学习.

比较按任务,机制和可再生性排列,不将论文报告不同数据集的数字合并为一等.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en:
The shared-SFT setting has a single training seed, and the training set has 677 records.
The net Standard gain of SFT is a point estimate whose interval contains zero; the 57 SFT-gained records lie in 28 image clusters, and the interval of the difference in gain retention rate is wide.
The image-cluster intervals of this paper measure sampling variation under fixed checkpoints and do not include the randomness of retraining.
blocks.zh:
共享-SFT设置有单一的训练种子,而训练集则有677个记录.
SFT的净标准收益是一个点估计值,其间隔为0;57个SFT得到的纪录位于28个图像集群中,而增益保留率相差相差相差相差很广.
本文的图像-集群间隔测量了固定检查站的抽样变化,不包括再培训的随机性.

blocks.en:
𝖤 \mathsf{E} is a historically exposed evaluation population, and 𝖨 \mathsf{I} provides a confirmation on independent images after the method was frozen. 𝖨 \mathsf{I} covers only AI2D science diagrams, the three failure types have different sample sizes, and the questions and transformations were reviewed by rules and by a multimodal model, without annotation by two human annotators.
That the images were not used in the development of this project does not exclude that the base model saw public AI2D data during pretraining or instruction tuning.
The abstention baseline of B1 is lower on 𝖨 \mathsf{I} than on 𝖤 \mathsf{E} , so the absolute gains on the two populations cannot be read directly as a change in the ability of the method; we interpret the results through the paired comparisons within each set.
On 𝖨 \mathsf{I} there are only 8 SFT-gained records in 7 clusters, and their retention counts do not support a new statistical conclusion.
blocks.zh:
E\mathsf{E}是历史上被曝光的评价人口,我\mathsf{I}在方法被冻结后在独立图像上提供了确认. I\mathsf{I}只覆盖了AI2D科学图,三种故障类型有不同的样本大小,问题和变换被规则和多模式审查,没有两位人名注释员的注释.
图片没有被用于这个项目的开发,这并不排除基础模型在预训或指令调试时看到公开的AI2D数据.
B1的弃权基线在 I\mathsf{I} 上比 E\mathsf{E} 低, 因此两个人群的绝对收益不能直接读作方法能力的改变; 我们通过每集的对等比较来解释结果 。
在 I\mathsf{I} 上, 只有 8 个 SFT 在 7 个集群中获得的记录, 它们的保留数不能支持新的统计结论 。

blocks.en:
The preceding SFT and the probe share the Standard records of 𝖳 \mathsf{T} .
The budget on 𝖢𝖬 \mathsf{CM} is an empirical constraint.

The results on the two original base models support fitting the pipeline separately on each base model; the results on retention after post-training currently come only from Qwen2.5-VL-3B.

blocks.en:
In an experiment with variations of the frozen prompt, part of the gain shrinks; these runs are not reported here.
The direct retention comparison for abstention by parameter update covers EmbLoRA and plain abstention SFT; the two differ in target text and prompt format, so plain abstention SFT is not a causal ablation that removes only the CLIP signal.
The CLIP classifier result is a mechanism port under the common prompt, fitted over a disclosed finite grid of candidates.
BICR keeps its core objective and search scheme and is adapted to the common B1 , data, and executor.

BICR保持其核心目标和搜索计划,并被适应普通B1,数据和执行者.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
On the present multimodal abstention task, a constraint on the loss of correct answers, combined with deterministic execution, turns an existing answerability score into favorable operating points between abstention and retention.
Record-level evaluation from a shared answer-SFT starting point shows that the abstention stage can keep all or most of the SFT-gained answers while adding correct abstentions.
The confirmation on independent images, run after the models and thresholds were frozen, further shows that the two preset operating points raise the correct-abstention rate while keeping all original correct answers.
Losses, corrections, and gain retention, together with net accuracy, show the actual trade-offs of the different abstention routes.
blocks.zh:
在目前的多式联运弃权任务中,对失去正确答案的限制,加上决定性的执行,将现有的可回答分数变为弃权与保留之间的有利操作分数。
来自共享答案-SFT起点的记录级评价显示,弃权阶段可以保留全部或大部分SFT获得的答案,同时加入正确的弃权.
在模型和阈值被冻结后运行的独立图像上的确认进一步显示,两个预设的操作点在保留所有原始正确答案的同时会提高正确吸收率.
损失、更正和收益保留,加上净准确性,显示不同弃权路线的实际取舍。

Mechanism port of the official repository [ 33 ] , with the model interface changed from Qwen2-VL to Qwen2.5-VL; we report it on the original Qwen2.5-VL-3B only.
Each record is answered under five perturbed versions of the input, which pair a blurred image with a rephrased question, and the uncertainty is the base-2 entropy of the answer clusters over the five samples.
In the native execution, a record with an uncertainty of at least 1.0 receives the displayed abstention letter, and every other record receives the initial answer, which is sampled at temperature 0.1.
Under the common executor, the uncertainty is used as the score, and the cached greedy answer of the base model is kept on the answered side.
Three deviations from the official code are disclosed.
The full question and hint are rephrased, where the official code rephrases the first line only.
Answers are clustered by the frozen option parser of the protocol, where the official code takes the first integer.
Records whose questions have an identical prefix share their rephrasings.

blocks.en:
The review of semantics uses fixed rules and a multimodal model.
Its inputs are limited to the original question, the options, the image, and the transformation; they do not include the answers, scores, or correctness of the branches under evaluation.
The 300 candidate clusters that entered the review were screened as in Table 15 , and the original correct answers were not modified.
All decisions were recorded, and the final sample was fixed before inference.
blocks.zh:
语义学的审查采用固定规则和多式模式.
其投入仅限于最初的问题,选项,图像,以及转变;它们不包括被评价分支的答案,分数或正确性.
进入审查的300个候选群组如表15所示进行了筛选,最初正确的答案没有修改。
所有决定都记录在案,最后的样本在推论前已经固定。

blocks.en:
Every Standard question keeps four substantive options and is rotated over all circular shifts; AAD rotates the three options that remain after the correct one is removed, and IASD and IVQD rotate four options.
The NOTA text is “None of the above” for AAD and IASD and “The image and question are irrelevant.” for IVQD, and it is fixed in the last position.
The unit of resampling consists of all Standard and UPD records of an original question together with its unique foreign image, which gives 228 clusters.
Inference uses a batch size of 1, greedy decoding, BF16 precision, and at most 1,024 new tokens.
blocks.zh:
每个标准问题保留了4个实质性选项,并在所有循环班次上被旋转;AAD在正确的一个被去掉后将剩下的3个选项进行旋转,而IASD和IVQD则旋转了4个选项.
NOTA文本是AAD和IASD的“上述任何一种”和“图像和问题无关”。 对于IVQD来说,它固定在最后的位置。
复刻的单位由原题的所有"标准"和"UPD"记录及其独特的外相组成,给出了228个集群.
推论使用批量尺寸为1,贪取解码,BF16精度,最多为1024个新符.
